req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-032 requires that every response body under /players/ includes the squadNumber field. The primary endpoint under test is GET /players/{id}. We need: (1) a positive EP test confirming squadNumber is present and correct for a known player, (2) a negative NEG test confirming a 404 for a non-existent UUID (error pathway), (3) a BVA boundary test using the lowest squad number (1) and highest (26) to confirm squadNumber appears at both extremes, (4) a DT test verifying the exact integer value of squadNumber matches the seeded data (kills constant/comparison mutations), and (5) an additional NEG test for a malformed UUID path parameter returning 422. Tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, assert exact status codes and exact field values to maximize mutation kill rate.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_positive():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'squadNumber' in body
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 1
    assert isinstance(body['squadNumber'], int)

test_get_player_by_id_includes_squad_number_positive()
